title: Device model
description: The class of a physical device, as the Kubernetes resource states it. The device management interface carries a message of the same name with a different field set; see the entity prose.

name.description: Resource name, from the object metadata. A device instance names its model by this.

properties.description: The properties instances of this model have.

type.description: How to read the characters a twin property carries for this name.

access-mode.description: Whether a desired value may be written. Wire key: accessMode.

unit.description: Unit of the reading, for readers rather than for validation.

visitors.description: Default instruction for reaching this property; a device instance may state its own.

protocol.description: Southbound protocol this model is served over. Absent from the interface message of the same name.

protocol-config-data.description: Protocol settings shared by every instance of the model. Wire key: protocolConfigData.
